name: River: the Range sausage (simulated)
description: Up and down the wide reach north of the Higher Ferry, between Dart Marina and Noss. Two laps; legs along the river, so a beat or a run when the wind blows up or down the river.

provenance.notes: Invented practice course placed by the developer in deep water clear of the mooring areas and ferry tracks in the geodata. Not an RDYC course; marks are not real.
